title: Restore the stock fork damping baseline

applicability.included: Exact standard US2025 YZ450F original stock suspension.
excluded: Other years, replacement springs/components or aftermarket damping conversions

entry_state: Assembled bike, serviceable stock suspension, exact original adjusters identified.
exit_state: Recorded adjustment and functional checks complete; no internal service performed.
preflight: Stop for leaks, damage, binding or an unidentified adjuster.
Keep the linked diagrams visible to identify distinct controls.
critical_stop_conditions: Adjuster at stop before target, inability to identify stock control, or unresolved setup measurement

required_tools.name: Appropriate damping driver and precision torque tool for1.3Nm

source.review_note: Root independently read allsteps and visually reviewed exact2025 PDF112–115/384–385; values andcontrolidentities confirmed. Sag forwardbranch preserves unchanged acceptedsetup; no physicalwork claimed.

steps.title: Inspect both legs
steps.instruction: Support the assembled bike upright. Inspect inner tubes for damage and fork joints for leaks. Apply front brake and compress the fork several times; it must rebound smoothly. Resolve damage/leaks/binding before adjusting.
verification: Confirm the described outcome; record actual settings/measurements where requested.
steps.origin: Original exact-source summary; recording/comparison are workflow adaptations.

steps.title: Record both sides
steps.instruction: Identify bottom rebound and top compression controls from PDF112. Gently turn each toward full hard, counting and saving the original clicks so they can be restored. Never force a stop. Actual total travel can vary from nominal; do not manufacture missing clicks.
verification: Confirm the described outcome; record actual settings/measurements where requested.
steps.origin: Original exact-source summary; recording/comparison are workflow adaptations.

steps.title: Release trapped air
steps.instruction: Raise front wheel securely. Remove each leg bleed screw shown PDF113 to release internal pressure, then refit each at1.3Nm. Keep dirt out and return both screws before setting damping.
verification: Confirm the described outcome; record actual settings/measurements where requested.
steps.origin: Original exact-source summary; recording/comparison are workflow adaptations.

steps.title: Set rebound
steps.instruction: From gently seated full hard, turn each lower rebound adjuster10 clicks outward in diagram direction b. Both legs must match. Source nominal range is0–20 clicks; stop if actual mechanism cannot reach the standard without force.
verification: Confirm the described outcome; record actual settings/measurements where requested.
steps.origin: Original exact-source summary; recording/comparison are workflow adaptations.

steps.title: Set compression
steps.instruction: From gently seated full hard, turn each top compression adjuster12 clicks outward in diagram direction b. Both legs must match. Source nominal range is0–20 clicks; never force beyond actual travel.
verification: Confirm the described outcome; record actual settings/measurements where requested.
steps.origin: Original exact-source summary; recording/comparison are workflow adaptations.

steps.title: Verify the baseline
steps.instruction: Lower the bike from its stand. Recheck smooth fork action, both secured bleed screws and matched settings. Record rebound10/compression12 clicks out per leg and any unresolved symptoms. This restores damping only; fork height, oil and springs were not changed.
verification: Confirm the described outcome; record actual settings/measurements where requested.
steps.origin: Original exact-source summary; recording/comparison are workflow adaptations.

completeness: Restore both original fork damping settings, release trapped air and record functional checks. Oil, springs and fork height remain unchanged.
